# Runtime dependencies for the pdvoice pipeline (pip / venv; no conda).
# Exact versions of the environment that produced every thesis result (Windows 10,
# Python 3.12, NVIDIA GPU with a CUDA 12.x driver).
#
# Install, from the project root (Windows paths; on Linux/macOS use .venv/bin/python):
#   python -m venv .venv
#   .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install torch==2.5.1 torchaudio==2.5.1 --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
#   .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r env/requirements-gpu.txt
#   .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -e .
# torch and torchaudio come from the CUDA index above and must match each other exactly
# (2.5.1+cu121); they are not listed here so pip does not replace them with CPU wheels.

# --- core numerics / data ---
numpy==1.26.4          # must stay below 2.0
pandas==3.0.5
scipy==1.17.1
scikit-learn==1.9.0    # StratifiedGroupKFold splits differ between versions
pyyaml==6.0.3
joblib==1.5.3
tqdm==4.70.0

# --- audio I/O + DSP ---
librosa==0.11.0
soundfile==0.14.0
audioread==3.1.0

# --- classical voice features (jitter/shimmer/HNR) ---
praat-parselmouth==0.4.7

# --- voice activity detection ---
silero-vad==6.2.1

# --- SSL encoders ---
# transformers 5.x refuses to load .bin weights unless torch>=2.6 (CVE-2025-32434 guard),
# and the encoders used here ship .bin only; 4.46.3 loads them with torch 2.5.1.
transformers==4.46.3

# --- re-implementation of Rahmatallah et al. 2025 (scripts/rahmatallah_cnn.py) ---
# Keras 3 on the torch backend; ml-dtypes must stay <0.5 or pip pulls numpy 2.x.
keras==3.15.1
ml-dtypes==0.4.1

# --- calibration / stats / plots ---
statsmodels==0.14.6
matplotlib==3.11.1

# --- notebooks + tests ---
ipykernel==7.3.0
jupyter==1.1.1
pytest==9.1.1

# --- Bridge2AI-Voice download (scripts/download_bridge2ai.py) ---
# the access token goes in ~/.synapseConfig, never in the repository
synapseclient==4.14.0
